title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Dispatch Standards: Channels, Response Target and Service Reach
content:
## Service standards carried by each Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan

The response target is the number of minutes within which the plan aims to reach the vehicle. The
service radius is the distance from the member's home city within which the plan dispatches, and each
mile beyond it carries the plan's out-of-radius rate. The duplicate window is the number of hours
within which a second call for the same fault counts as the same callout. Each plan also states the
channels through which assistance may be requested.

| Plan | Channels through which assistance may be requested | Response target (minutes) | Service radius from the member's home city (miles) | Each mile beyond the radius (USD) | Duplicate window (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | the Keyturn app; the telephone line | 90 | 25 | 4.50 | 24 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | the Keyturn app; the telephone line | 75 | 50 | 4.25 | 24 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | the Keyturn app; the telephone line; a partner system interface | 60 | 100 | 3.75 | 12 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | the Keyturn app; a partner system interface | 60 | 75 | 3.95 | 12 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | the Keyturn app; the telephone line; a partner system interface | 45 | 150 | 3.25 | 12 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | the Keyturn app; the telephone line; a partner system interface | 30 | 300 | 2.95 | 6 |

### Notes on the standards

1. The Keyturn app is carried on all six plans. The telephone line is carried on every plan except
   Keyturn Roadside EV Cover. A partner system interface is carried on Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover,
   Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
2. The response target shortens as the plan rises, from 90 minutes on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover to
   30 minutes on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover, with Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn
   Roadside EV Cover standing together at 60 minutes.
3. The duplicate window stands at 24 hours on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover and Keyturn Roadside Plus
   Cover, at 12 hours on Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover, Keyturn Roadside EV Cover and Keyturn Roadside
   Fleet Cover, and at 6 hours on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
